# GitHub repository description and topics

These are the prepared About settings for
[cihankaya77/confiSSH](https://github.com/cihankaya77/confiSSH).
Committing this file does not apply them to GitHub. Set them through the
repository's **About → Edit** control or the GitHub CLI command below.

## Description

```text
SSH connection manager for Linux: organize servers, edit OpenSSH config, browse SSH keys, and connect in your terminal. Groups, favorites, jump hosts, tunnels, and automatic backups.
```

## Website

```text
https://github.com/cihankaya77/confiSSH/releases/latest
```

## Topics

```text
ssh openssh ssh-client ssh-manager ssh-config ssh-keys ssh-tunnel connection-manager linux linux-desktop gtk python sysadmin devops homelab
```

The topics describe the app's purpose, platform, and use cases. Keep this list
consistent with the features the application actually supports.
[GitHub's topic guide](https://docs.github.com/en/repositories/managing-your-repositorys-settings-and-features/customizing-your-repository/classifying-your-repository-with-topics)
explains how topics help people find repositories.

## Apply with GitHub CLI

Run this after installing GitHub CLI and signing in with `gh auth login` using
an account allowed to edit this repository. It updates the description and
website and adds the topics, preserving existing topics.

```bash
gh repo edit cihankaya77/confiSSH \
  --description 'SSH connection manager for Linux: organize servers, edit OpenSSH config, browse SSH keys, and connect in your terminal. Groups, favorites, jump hosts, tunnels, and automatic backups.' \
  --homepage 'https://github.com/cihankaya77/confiSSH/releases/latest' \
  --add-topic ssh,openssh,ssh-client,ssh-manager,ssh-config,ssh-keys,ssh-tunnel,connection-manager,linux,linux-desktop,gtk,python,sysadmin,devops,homelab
```

GitHub allows up to 20 topics in total. Review any existing topics before adding
this set. See the [GitHub CLI reference](https://cli.github.com/manual/gh_repo_edit)
for these options.

README, davranış kuralları ve PR şablonu ise dosyalar ana dala gönderildiğinde
